positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
-Development and design of multi-platform web application using React, RESTful API, MongoDB, and Learning Locker 
-Built multi-platform web based training simulations using React
-Designed UI for applications with user experience and scalable development in mind
-Leveraged user feedback to improve design and experience of web applications
-Worked across multiple teams to meet customer requirements and ensure project timeline
-Collaborate with team members to estimate projects and features

positions.title: Web Developer and Designer
positions.description:
-Designed and developed company and subsidiary company websites with HTML and JavaScript
-Designed UI and UX for online retail outlet
-Created marketing collateral as print, digital, and interactive experiences
-Developed marketing research strategy with sales team to improve national sales 
-Photographed and retouched full product lines

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
- Developed web based training in Flash using Actionscript
- Front end design of iOS app and other digital assets for dealership training program
- Created maintainable standards for print and digital training materials
